section.7: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Prostration while reciting the Qur'an

7.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Prostration while reciting the Qur'an

hadiths.text: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not make a prostration at any verse in al-Mufassal from the time he moved to Medina
